About the game

Toy Quarter is a cosy 3D management game about growing a small toy shop into a toy empire. You do not just sell toys - you make them.

Pick a toy at a workbench and watch your worker build it four at a time, pack the crate, carry it to a shelf and see each customer take one home and pay at the till. Customers show what they want and why they left, and simple advice cards turn that into your next move.

Every level-up lets you choose one of two new toys, so your range grows your way. Hire specialists, add painting and testing stations, expand the building and open new shops across a district full of different customers. Seven story chapters lead to a flagship store - and then the business keeps growing.

Features

  • Make every toy yourself

    Pick a toy at the workbench. Your workers build it four at a time, pack the crate and carry it to the shelf.

  • Customers you can read

    Thought bubbles show what each customer wants and why they left - sold out, too pricey, waited too long.

  • A new toy at every level

    Choose one of two new toys at each level-up. 22 toys in 10 categories, and new toys arrive with a rush of buyers.

  • Build the shop your way

    Grid building with walls and rooms: place benches, shelves, decor and the till, then expand the building.

  • Hire a real team

    11 staff roles, from assemblers and packers to painters, testers and designers in your own design studio.

  • From one shop to a district

    Open shops on 8 sites with different customers. Seven chapters lead to the flagship store, then open play.
